description: This Java class defines an ItemSelectionTracker utility for managing item selections within a RecyclerView in an Android application, leveraging the AndroidX RecyclerView Selection library.

classes.name: ItemSelectionTracker
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and configuring a SelectionTracker for RecyclerView items, with specific selection predicate logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured SelectionTracker instance for a given RecyclerView and ItemAdapter, specifying selection rules and storage strategy.
